name: bowel
description: Read and troubleshoot bowel, a mihomo (Clash Meta) proxy client; changes ask you first.
long_description:
bowel's MCP server lets an agent read its status, routes, nodes, rules, connections and the core's log, test where an address would go, and troubleshoot connections. Changes such as the mode, a route's node or a rule follow the policy in bowel's settings, which by default asks you first in a dialog.

This bundle runs the MCP server of the bowel app installed on this computer (`bowel mcp`), so bowel must be installed: https://github.com/21stware/bowel/releases/latest. On macOS it opens bowel when it isn't running; on Windows and Linux, start bowel first.

bowel_path.title: bowel program
bowel_path.description: Only if bowel is not in the usual place: /Applications/bowel.app/Contents/MacOS/bowel on macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\bowel\bowel.exe on Windows, /opt/bowel/bowel on Linux.
